env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^1 2 0 3$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/structbrace

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	a := struct {
		A int = 1
		B struct{}
	}{}
	c := struct {
		N int = 2
		M map[string]struct{}
	}{}
	d := struct {
		K int = 3
		I interface{ M() }
	}{}
	fmt.Println(a.A, c.N, len(c.M), d.K)
}
